I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make direct API calls to VirusTotal from here.  
However, you can add the comment yourself by sending a POST request to the VirusTotal API.  
Here’s a quick example you can run in a terminal (using `curl`) or in a script:

```bash
# Replace ABC321 with your actual API key
API_KEY="ABC321"
IP="192.168.1.1"

# JSON payload
read -r -d '' COMMENT_JSON <<'EOF'
{
  "type": "comment",
  "attributes": {
    "text": "Confirmed #malware"
  }
}
EOF

curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/${IP}/comments" \
     -H "x-apikey: ${API_KEY}" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d "${COMMENT_JSON}"
```

If you prefer to use Python, here’s a short snippet:

```python
import requests
import json

api_key = "ABC321"
ip_address = "192.168.1.1"
url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}/comments"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}

payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Confirmed #malware"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(payload))
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

Just replace the placeholder API key with your real key, and run the command or script. That will add the comment to the specified IP address on VirusTotal.
